context: Tests whether the agent picks an options-style sibling and its matching base class, not the plain field base, and still completes the wiring.

checklist.name: Options sibling chosen
checklist.description: Copies an options component such as `radiogroup` or `checkboxgroup`, and `REPORT.md` says which and why

checklist.name: Options base class
checklist.description: The impl extends the options-field base class used by that sibling, not the plain field base class

checklist.name: Creation order
checklist.description: `FormConstants` entry, interface and impl are created before the `ui.af.apps` files

checklist.name: Unit test fixtures
checklist.description: A unit test with `test-content.json` and exporter JSON is added under `bundles/af-core/src/test`

checklist.name: Example proxy and page
checklist.description: An example proxy and an example page are added under `examples`

checklist.name: Runtime embed
checklist.description: The component's site clientlib category is added to the `core-forms-components-runtime-all` embed

checklist.name: Accessibility
checklist.description: Walks the accessibility checklist and the markup gives the choices a group role and a label association

checklist.name: Honest report
checklist.description: `REPORT.md` names every gate that was not run, with its command
